activities.instructions: Ayuda a la rana a cruzar el río eligiendo el nenúfar correcto en cada salto.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: The alarm system hasn't worked properly [gap1] the power cut.
rounds.explanation: «The power cut» identifica el acontecimiento que inició el problema.

rounds.prompt: We haven't used the meeting room [gap1] several weeks.
rounds.explanation: «Several weeks» mide una duración y se introduce con «for».

rounds.prompt: The café has been closed [gap1] Monday.
rounds.explanation: «Monday» es el momento en que comenzó el cierre.

rounds.prompt: Select the natural way to describe long-term ownership that continues now.

options.text: We've had this sofa since we moved in.
We have this sofa for we moved in.
We've been having this sofa since we have moved in.

rounds.explanation: La posesión usa present perfect simple y el acontecimiento tras «since» usa past simple.

rounds.prompt: It's been three months [gap1] I last drove.
rounds.explanation: La estructura es «It has been + periodo + since + past simple».

rounds.prompt: Leila started teaching at this school ten years ago and still teaches there.

options.text: Leila taught at this school for ten years.
Leila has taught at this school for ten years.
Leila has teach at this school since ten years.

rounds.explanation: Como el trabajo continúa, usamos present perfect con «for ten years».

rounds.prompt: The old office closed after five years. The current office opened in 2021 and remains open.

options.text: We have used both offices during five years since 2021.
We used the old office for five years, and we've used the current one since 2021.
We used the old office since five years, and use the current one for 2021.

rounds.explanation: El periodo terminado usa past simple con «for»; el vigente usa present perfect con «since».

rounds.prompt: I've worked from home since I [gap1] to this town.
rounds.explanation: El acontecimiento inicial terminado usa past simple: «since I moved».

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Colócate en el carril de la respuesta correcta antes de cruzar cada puerta.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: I still trust my adviser. That trust began when she helped me resolve my first case.

options.text: I trust my adviser during she helped me resolve my first case.
I've been trusting my adviser for she helped my first case.
I've trusted my adviser since she helped me resolve my first case.

rounds.explanation: El estado vigente usa present perfect; el hecho inicial tras «since» usa past simple.

rounds.prompt: How long [gap1] Amir [gap2] in customer support?
rounds.explanation: Con «Amir» usamos «has», seguido del participio «worked».

rounds.prompt: Neither lift has been available [gap1] more than forty-eight hours.
rounds.explanation: «More than forty-eight hours» es una duración y requiere «for».

rounds.prompt: Ask when someone's ownership of a bicycle began.

options.text: Since when you had that bicycle?
How many time have you that bicycle?
How long have you had that bicycle?

rounds.explanation: Una posesión que continúa se pregunta con «How long have you had ...?».

rounds.prompt: Ask about the length of time the road has been closed.

options.text: How long has the road been closed?
How long is the road closed since?
For how long does the road been closed?

rounds.explanation: La pregunta coloca «has» antes del sujeto y conserva «been closed».

rounds.prompt: We moved away from Bristol in 2020 after living there for eight years.

options.text: We live in Bristol for eight years ago.
We lived in Bristol for eight years.
We have been living in Bristol since eight years.

rounds.explanation: La residencia terminó en 2020, por eso usamos past simple aunque aparezca «for».

rounds.prompt: Tariq has owned this shop [gap1] he left college.
rounds.explanation: La oración «he left college» marca el acontecimiento inicial y va detrás de «since».

rounds.prompt: I last spoke to Ana eighteen months ago.

options.text: I haven't spoken to Ana for eighteen months.
I haven't spoken to Ana since eighteen months.
I haven't been knowing Ana during eighteen months.

rounds.explanation: El periodo sin hablar continúa hasta ahora y «eighteen months» va con «for».

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Apila los fragmentos en orden para levantar la frase.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Select the sentence that describes continuing ownership by an organisation.

options.text: The charity has owned the building for most of its history.
The charity has owned the building during twenty years since.
The charity has been owning the building since most of its history.

rounds.explanation: «Own» es de estado y usa present perfect simple; «most of its history» es un periodo.

rounds.prompt: I [gap1] Sam for a long time.
rounds.explanation: La relación continúa y «known» es el participio de «know».

rounds.prompt: The river has been cleaner since the factory [gap1] its new filters.
rounds.explanation: La instalación es el acontecimiento inicial terminado, por eso usa past simple.

rounds.prompt: A subscription began in March and remains active.

options.text: The subscription is active since March ago.
The subscription was active for March.
The subscription has been active since March.

rounds.explanation: El estado continúa y «March» marca su inicio: «has been active since March».

rounds.prompt: The course ended last month. You met your project partner while it was taking place.

options.text: I've known my partner during three years.
I met my project partner during the course.

rounds.explanation: «During» sitúa el encuentro dentro del curso; no mide la duración de un estado.

rounds.prompt: Mina has worked here [gap1] 2022.
rounds.explanation: «2022» identifica el punto de inicio y requiere «since».

rounds.prompt: It [gap1] nearly a decade since the bridge last required major repairs.
rounds.explanation: La estructura de tiempo transcurrido es «It has been + periodo + since...».

rounds.prompt: We've lived in this flat [gap1] six years.
rounds.explanation: «Six years» es un periodo de duración, por lo que usamos «for».

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.
